statement: CISA adds CVE-2026-109618 or CVE-2026-109619, the PHP2Shell remote code execution flaws in PHP, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-10-21 and 2026-11-20.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog lists CVE-2026-109618 or CVE-2026-109619 with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-21 and 2026-11-20 inclusive.
failure_condition: Neither PHP2Shell CVE has been added to the CISA KEV catalog with an addition date from 2026-10-21 through 2026-11-20.

statement: The Federal Open Market Committee announces an increase in the federal funds target range at its scheduled meeting concluding on 2026-12-09.
resolution: The FOMC statement dated 2026-12-09 raises the target range; equivalently, FRED series DFEDTARU for 2026-12-10 exceeds its 2026-12-08 value. A hold or cut resolves false.
failure_condition: The federal funds target range in effect on 2026-12-10 is no higher than the range in effect on 2026-12-08.

statement: Moodys lowers the long-term issuer rating of the Government of France by at least one notch in a rating action published between 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: A rating action on moodys.com, or the Agence France Tresor ratings page, shows a Moodys downgrade of France dated 2026-10-22 to 2026-10-30. An affirmation or outlook-only change resolves false.
failure_condition: France holds the same Moodys long-term rating on 2026-10-30 that it held at the packet date.

statement: The WTI Cushing spot crude oil price for 2026-12-31 is below 80.00 dollars per barrel. Reference: 97.86 dollars per barrel on the packet date per the report market snapshot.
resolution: FRED series DCOILWTICO (EIA WTI Cushing spot) shows a value below 80.00 for 2026-12-31. If no value is recorded that day, use the last value on or before 2026-12-31.
failure_condition: The WTI Cushing spot price for 2026-12-31 is at or above 80.00 dollars per barrel.

statement: A member of the House Democratic Caucus is elected Speaker of the US House of Representatives for the 120th Congress in a vote held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-10.
resolution: The Clerk of the House roll call for election of the Speaker, held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-10, records a Democrat elected. Another winner, or no Speaker elected in that window, resolves false.
failure_condition: By the end of 2027-01-10 the House has not elected a Democratic Speaker for the 120th Congress.

statement: The French National Assembly adopts a motion of censure, bringing down the sitting government, in a vote held between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: Assemblee nationale records or the Journal officiel show a motion de censure adopted under Article 49 of the Constitution in a sitting held between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-31.
failure_condition: No motion of censure is adopted by the National Assembly between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-31.

statement: A general ceasefire covering the entire Russia-Ukraine front line takes effect between 2026-10-22 and 2027-01-31, declared in force by both the Russian and Ukrainian governments.
resolution: The Kremlin and the Office of the President of Ukraine each declare a front-wide general ceasefire in effect, starting between 2026-10-22 and 2027-01-31, per Reuters or AP. Partial, energy-only or sub-30-day truces resolve false.
failure_condition: No front-wide general ceasefire accepted by both Moscow and Kyiv enters into force between 2026-10-22 and 2027-01-31.

statement: The United States and Iran both publicly confirm an agreement or understanding on commercial shipping passage through the Strait of Hormuz, announced between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: The White House or State Department and the Iranian foreign ministry each publicly confirm a Hormuz shipping agreement or understanding announced between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-31, as reported by Reuters or AP.
failure_condition: No agreement or understanding on Hormuz shipping acknowledged by both Washington and Tehran is announced between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-31.

statement: Kenya reaches a cumulative total of 20 or more laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases in an official count dated between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-15. Reference: nine confirmed cases at the packet date per item 100.
resolution: A WHO Disease Outbreak News post, WHO AFRO situation report, or Kenya Ministry of Health statement dated 2026-10-22 to 2026-12-15 gives Kenya a cumulative confirmed Ebola case count of 20 or more.
failure_condition: The cumulative number of laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases in Kenya remains below 20 through 2026-12-15.

statement: The US Department of Justice announces criminal charges against, or the arrest or extradition of, at least one person for SafePay ransomware activity between 2026-10-22 and 2027-04-09.
resolution: A justice.gov press release dated 2026-10-22 to 2027-04-09 announces charges, an arrest, or an extradition of a named or unnamed defendant for participation in SafePay ransomware operations.
failure_condition: No person is publicly charged, arrested, or extradited by US authorities for SafePay ransomware activity between 2026-10-22 and 2027-04-09.
